newsitem.title: EGYPT: Central Egypt Flour Mills 1995/6 profits up.
newsitem.headline: Central Egypt Flour Mills 1995/6 profits up.

text.p: Central Egypt Flour Mills made net after-tax profits of 33.5 million pounds in the financial year 1995/6, 35.6 percent up on 24.7 million in 1994/5, according to audited results available on Sunday.
Turnover rose to 568.7 million pounds, 29.7 percent up on 438.5 million in the previous year, and profits before tax were 45.0 million, 47.1 percent up on 30.6 million.
The state privatised about 2.8 million of the company's 9.35 million shares in April at 18.00 pounds each. The shares closed on the Egyptian stock exchange last week at 28.50 pounds.
The results did not mention any dividend.
